verse_translation.google_trans: Thus Vivasvata, my father, by the brightness of the best light All the enemies were burnt down and lived in all the earth

verse_sans_lines: निर्दग्धाः शत्रवः सर्वे वसता भुवि सर्वशः

verse_translation.google_trans: And while Vishnu lived in the house of Dasaratha The ten-headed was killed in the battle with Bhimakarma

verse_sans_lines: विष्णुना वसता चापि गृहे दशरथस्य वै

verse_translation.google_trans: Thus these great souls disguised here and there Invincible in battle, you will win the same way
and was satisfied with the words of Dhaumya, the knower of righteousness. Yudhisthira did not move with the intellect of the scriptures and his own intelligence

verse_sans_lines: शास्त्रबुद्ध्या स्वबुद्ध्या च न चचाल युधिष्ठिरः

verse_translation.google_trans: Then the mighty-armed Bhimasena was very strong The best of the strong of the king is delighted in words
Avekshaya maharaja tava gandivadhanvana Nothing dared by the intellect followed by religion
Sahadeva I always stopped Nakula They were both powerful and terrible in their destruction
We will not give up that in which you will engage us You will defeat all that will soon conquer others

verse_sans_lines: न वयं तत्प्रहास्यामो यस्मिन्योक्ष्यति नो भवान्

verse_translation.google_trans: When Bhimasena said this, the Brahmins were supremely blessed Used and inquired of Bharata as his own life span
All the Vedas are the chief ascetics and sages Blessings and assisted as they are looking for again
With Dhaumya, the learned and those five Pandavas The heroes got up and went to Krishna and went to India

verse_sans_lines: सह धौम्येन विद्वांसस्तथा ते पञ्च पाण्डवाः

verse_translation.google_trans: Only a krosa, from that country for the sake of the country. The tigers of men were ready to live in the hope
All the separate scriptures and all the experts in mantras Sandhivigrahakalajnaya mantraya samaupavishan
